metadata.name: openclaw-persona-forge
metadata.description: Forge a complete lobster persona for an OpenClaw AI agent from user preferences or a random gacha draw. Provide identity, SOUL.md, character-specific boundaries, a name, and an avatar prompt. Use an available reviewed image-generation skill for a consistent avatar when permitted. Use when creating, designing, or customizing an OpenClaw lobster persona. Not for minor edits to an existing SOUL.md, personas for other platforms, or purely functional agents without a personality. Trigger concepts: lobster soul, OpenClaw soul, lobster character, identity, roleplay or game character, NPC, personality, backstory, random lobster, SOUL, and gacha.
